capabilities: Transcribe handwriting into a searchable text layer
Embed inline sketch blocks in regular notes
Add ruled, dotted, or grid paper guides
Run handwriting recognition via cloud, on-device, or manual entry
disambiguation: Not a drawing-only canvas; ink is stored inside ordinary markdown notes so search, graph, and backlinks index the text layer.
extras: On-device TrOCR recognition is desktop-only, English-only, and less accurate than cloud; iPad requires turning off iPadOS Scribble or fast strokes drop. API keys are stored locally in the vault plugin data. Installable from community plugins (pending), BRAT (pcrausaz/obsidian-inkedmark), or manual copy.
problem: Obsidian has no way to write or draw by hand inside a note, so handwritten diagrams, math, and marginalia cannot be searched, linked, or graphed.

requires.name: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint for cloud recognition
Hugging Face model download for on-device recognition

summary: Handwriting plugin that stores pressure-aware ink inside markdown notes with a searchable text layer and inline sketch blocks.
